overall: The AG found the Fall River Traffic Commission Board violated the Open Meeting Law by holding its July 29, 2020 meeting with the building closed to the public and no real-time remote access; a later posted recording did not cure it.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board met in person on July 29 without letting the public attend in person, and gave no live remote access to the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the meeting location for the July 29 meeting at One Government Center was “closed to the public” yet real-time access to the meeting was not provided on the Fall River Government Television website or on Channel 18.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law’s requirements, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
